meta.purpose: 为化学间隙层 v0.2『生物ET链=驻留深度甜蜜点级联』主张提供逐站参数底座（ΔG°、k、距离、λ），供甜蜜点比值判读（任务C）
meta.discipline_note: 每个数值只来自 2026-09-02 实际访问到的文本（Europe PMC REST / PubMed eutils / NCBI PMC efetch / PMC 网页 / Nobel PDF / Crossref）；访问不到的标 unverified 并放『待核验参考』，训练记忆值一律不入核验字段。

electron_bifurcation_PNAS2020.quote: For decades, it was unknown how electron-bifurcating systems in nature prevented energy-wasting short-circuiting reactions that have large driving forces ...
